method: Make the filling first. Warm the cooked chicken breast through in the hot pan until piping hot and lightly coloured. It is already cooked, so stop before it dries out.

Keep the lettuce, tomato and other fresh/crunchy ingredients out of the pan. Mix the measured sauce or dressing with the cooked chicken breast; if the filling is being served hot, reduce only the sauce-coated cooked chicken breast until it is no longer wet enough to soak the wrap.
Warm the wrap, then layer the filling through the centre with the fresh/crunchy elements last. Do not overfill it just because you can.
Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes if you want a crisp finish.

review.notes: Plain wholemeal wrap with reheated cooked chicken, fresh lettuce/tomato and lemon herb yoghurt; no cheese or lemon wedge.
